answer: Decaying reputation with mandatory renewal stops sybils: an identity weight halves each epoch unless renewed by fresh attestations from three unrelated peers, like a vine that withers without new growth. A forge of fake accounts cannot rest on old history; each sockpuppet must keep earning new peer attestations every epoch or fade to zero. One honest user renews once cheaply, while an attacker running a thousand fakes must continuously manufacture a thousand fresh attestations per epoch, a plume of cost that grows with every cycle instead of a one-time payment.
